key_entities: Streaming validation (use when Discovery is sharded)
propositions: Discovery skill lacked concerns 9, 10, 11 covering unwired/partially-wired functionality, comment-quality sharding, and test-suite health which were high-yield findings in the 2026-08-05/06 rebar-janitor run.

Two concerns (comment quality and test-suite health) are oversized for a single subagent with no sharding or streaming-validation guidance, causing runs to either batch unreviewable pools or skip concerns on volume grounds.
Verification phase had no guidance for validating a sharded discovery stream.

Three Markdown files in the packaged skill (SKILL.md, phases/discovery.md, phases/verification.md) require prose-only edits to document the three new discovery concerns, add streaming-validation principles, and establish sharding operating rules.
The content was already authored in the operator's working tree and must be transferred verbatim (byte-identical) into main via Gerrit to preserve fidelity with the live skill.
No Python source or runtime behavior changes are required; the skill is prose consumed by an agent harness.
